search_query.description: the paper-search query for the direction: words joined with `+`, a phrase inside double quotes; a paper must contain every word and phrase

activity.description: agent-owned: arXiv paper counts for `search_query`, the rule they were judged by and the verdict, written by code; absent until the first count

papers_recent.description: papers matching `search_query` submitted in the latest window

papers_previous.description: the same count in the window before

field_recent.description: every paper of the counted arXiv categories in the latest window, the field the direction is compared with

field_previous.description: the same count in the window before

window_days.description: length of each window in days

min_papers_high_volume.description: the rule, high volume: `papers_recent` that make a direction hot whatever its growth; absent on a block written before 2.1, which was judged by the rising rule alone

min_papers.description: the rule, rising: fewest `papers_recent` a direction that is hot by its growth has

min_growth_vs_field.description: the rule, rising: how many times the field's growth (`field_recent / field_previous`) the direction's growth (`papers_recent / papers_previous`) is, at least

is_hot.description: the verdict of the rule on these counts

observed_at.description: the day the counts were read; refreshed only when a figure changed

source.description: the arXiv API address that gave `papers_recent`; it states the query, the categories and the window
